test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which is Asia's biggest bus terminus?

options.text: Tel Aviv Central Bus Stand in Tel Aviv
Port Authority Bus Terminal in New York City
Chennai Mofussil Bus Terminus in Chennai

solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai Mofussil Bus Terminus in Chennai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chennai Mofussil Bus Terminus** (CMBT) is a bus terminal in **Chennai, India,** that offers inter-state bus services.
 
• It's between **SAF Games Village **and the **Koyambedu Vegetable Market **on the 100-foot (30-meter) inner-ring road (Jawaharlal Nehru Road) in Koyambedu.
 
• It is** Asia's largest bus terminal.**
 
• It is also **India's second-largest bus depot**, behind Delhi's Millennium Park Bus Depot.
 
• Since** 2015,** Chennai Metro Rail has operated a coach depot behind the bus terminal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Governor of Tamil Nadu is **Mr. R. N. Ravi** and Chief Minister is M. K. Stalin.
 
• Tamil culture and tradition are inextricably linked to **Jallikattu**. For centuries, the sport of taming the bull has been organized and played. Special Bos indicus bulls are produced and used for the festival.
 
• **Pongal **is a harvest festival held in Chennai and is one of India's most popular holidays. It is a four-day fair during which farmers pray to God for a prosperous harvest.
 
• **Bharatnatyam **is the popular traditional dance of the state.
 
• **Kolattam**, **Karagam**, and **Mayilattam **are famous folk dances.
 
• Nuclear Power Stations in Tamil Nadu are Madras Atomic Power Station, **Kalpakkam, **and **Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant, Kudankulam**.
 
• With many factories and numerous ports, Tamil is also one of the most industrialized states in India.
 
• Tamil has three major ports (Chennai, Ennore, and Tuticorin) — more than any other Indian state.
 
• **Mudumalai National Park** and Wildlife Sanctuary is a thick forest reserve that is home to Indian elephants, Bengal tigers, and Indian leopards.
 
• Tamil Nadu is home to over 30,000 Hindu temples, and many of them are centuries old. The **Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple **is one of the most famous.
 
• Many minerals — including lignite, limestone, magnesite, mica, quartz, felspar, bauxite, and gypsum — are found in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Tamil Nadu is also an agricultural state. It’s the largest producer of bananas, turmeric, flowers, and tapioca in India. It’s also a major producer of mango, coconut, groundnut, coffee, and sugarcane.
